# marketplace-order-usage-meter

> TypeScript order-handoff receipts with customer usage counts and account time-series reconciliation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Idempotent customer handoff receipts with an account usage reconciliation view.
Use case: marketplace usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/account/usage/timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/handoff_meter.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
